expectations.expected: Applicability is evaluation of the applies predicate. A missing or ambiguous premise cannot be falsified; it is indeterminate, or out_of_frame where a needed relation is undeclared. Unresolved applicability remains required coverage.

Out_of_frame has ground in an undeclared material relation/capability. Indeterminate has ground in insufficient available admissible evidence. If both grounds coexist, either returned value is lawful when it names that ground; neither is excluded.

A refinement names the mapping question/predicate and maps each value exactly once to its named parent/core value. The given applicability paragraph does not supply an exclusive override choosing out_of_frame over indeterminate whenever grounds coexist.

target_expected_repair: Remove the exclusive rather-than precedence while retaining missing/ambiguous premise conditions, the undeclared relation ground, and the governing non-falsified unresolved outcome. Author the exact replacement only after inspecting the bounded target record.
